about_the_game:
RIBBITS is a voice-input based, voice-action cooperative platformer!

Players control frogs that adjust their jump strength using the volume of their voices, and work together by connecting their tongues like ropes to overcome obstacles.

Shout, cooperate, and team up with your friends to reach your goal!

Voice-Action Jump System
RIBBITS requires the use of a microphone. The height and strength of your jumps change depending on the volume of your voice input.

Rope-Based Cooperative Platforming
Players are connected by their tongues, functioning like ropes. This connection must be used to pull each other and overcome a variety of obstacles.

Absurd Humor and Quirky Worldbuilding
The game features the silly charm of frogs and a low-poly art style, creating funny and ridiculous moments throughout the gameplay.

A New Form of Cooperative Experience
There are many areas that cannot be cleared without teamwork. Experience a unique form of cooperative play where voices and jumps come together as the core mechanic.


■ A microphone is required.
■ For a smooth multiplayer experience, a stable internet connection and another player registered as a Steam friend are necessary.
